title: Fell
description: A lightweight, highly configurable, Tree Felling mod.
body:
# Fell
Fell is a lightweight and configurable Tree Felling mod.

Breaking trees without crouching and whilst using the correct tool will cause the entire tree to break and collapse to the side. Similar to Create's Saw.

Axes are enchantable with the Felling enchantment which allows them to fell trees if "Global Axe Felling" is disabled.

### Block Tags:
- "fell:tree_attachments" -> Blocks that can be found as a part of a tree and will be included in the felling.
- "fell:custom_leaves" -> Extra blocks that count as leaves but don't have the "distance" property.
### Item Tags:
- "fell:builtin_felling" -> Items that will always be able to fell trees.
- "fell:felling_blacklist" -> Items that cannot, under any circumstances, use felling. Bypasses "Global Axe Felling" & the Enchantment.

### Configs
- "Disable Felling Enchantment" -> Stops Items from being enchanted with the Felling enchantment.
- "Global Axe Felling" -> Every item under the "minecraft:axes" tag can fell trees.

## For Developers
Fell offers the `IFellTrees` interface for your items that will bypass any of our configs or tag requirements and allows you to define custom logic for if your item should fell trees via the BlockBreak event.
